name: 49036 · Coldwater, MI
findings: ZIP 49036 (Coldwater) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49036 (Coldwater) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49036 (Coldwater) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
